Download a job's page snapshot (the final step's by default)

Usage:
  kaab jobs snapshot JOB_ID [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for snapshot
  -o, --output string   write to this file instead of stdout
      --step string     the step whose snapshot to download (steps[1])

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)
